brands.evidence: Monzo is the best all-rounder for everyday use and budgeting.
Starling is the best free replacement for a high-street bank.
Revolut is best if you travel or move money across borders.
Chase is best for an easy-access savings account with occasional cashback

client_claims.note: No fact covers Monzo support channels.

client_claims.text: Monzo is free and has a full UK banking licence.
client_claims.note: Monzo is a UK authorised bank; the free plan exists per F7.

client_claims.text: One source puts Monzo's savings rate at 4.0% AER.
client_claims.note: F9 says 2.80% AER on the free plan, but the answer attributes 4.0% to a source and may describe a different product or condition.

client_claims.note: Facts do not cover opening as a secondary account.
